ops.title: Account for global anonymous pages outside measured task ledgers
ops.premise:
Owner: /root/anonymous_ram_now, coordinated by /root.

Premise: The 2026-10-30 06:55 PDT host window reports 206.94 GiB pageable anonymous memory, while 1465 readable tasks total 71.59 GiB physical footprint and 155.65 GiB RSS. These are different non-unique accounting categories; this is an attribution question, not proof of a leak. A later read found 69.10 GiB globally allocator-reusable pages; selected 12 tasks account for 35.26 GiB reusable, including Claude60452 11.28 GiB and CCX60694 5.895 GiB. GPU driver counters show 9.26 GiB allocated/3.82 GiB in use; overlap is unknown.

Next executable step: root-review and combine the bounded privileged rusage census with the existing finite disk trace approval, then compare all-task footprints/RSS with the already captured global categories. No process maps, argv/environment secrets, protected-session signals, artificial memory pressure, or foreign madvise.

Acceptance: produce a bounded accounting reconciliation with UNKNOWN residual explicit; prove or refute an actionable excessive live allocation with source evidence; if confirmed, implement and independently verify reduction through release/install, otherwise exonerate the precise hypothesis. Raw-free target remains153.6 GiB and is not met. Do not force-close on normal pressure alone.

Evidence: fundamental-efficiency/aligned-host-relief/native-window.json; anonymous-ram-selected-now.json; anonymous-ram-gpu-now.json; anonymous-ram-root-rusage-candidate.py. Primary local purge(8) explicitly excludes anonymous malloc/vm_allocate memory, so repeating purge cannot reclaim reusable anonymous pages.
